title: Agistator
summary: AGIST'OR, or AGISTA'TOR noun An officer of the king's forest, who has the care of cattle agisted, and collects the money for the same; hence called gist-taker, which in England is corrupted into guest

inlines.v: AGIST'OR, or AGISTA'TOR noun An officer of the king's forest, who has the care of cattle agisted, and collects the money for the same; hence called gist-taker, which in England is corrupted into guest-taker.
